description: This file contains unit tests for the HandlerUtil utility class in the OpenMRS project. It tests methods related to obtaining and handling validators for various model classes such as Order, DrugOrder, Patient, and Person.

classes.name: HandlerUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of HandlerUtil utility methods in the context of validator handling within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: getHandlersForType_shouldReturnAListOfAllClassesThatCanHandleThePassedType
methods.description: Test that HandlerUtil.getHandlersForType returns a list of validators capable of handling specific model classes, such as Order and DrugOrder.

methods.name: getHandlersForType_shouldReturnAnEmptyListIfNoClassesCanHandleThePassedType
methods.description: Test that getHandlersForType returns an empty list when no suitable handlers are found for the given class.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler_shouldReturnThePreferredHandlerForThePassedHandlerAndType
methods.description: Test that getPreferredHandler retrieves the expected validator for a specific class, e.g., DrugOrder.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler_shouldThrowAAPIExceptionExceptionIfNoHandlerIsFound
methods.description: Test that getPreferredHandler throws an APIException when no suitable handler is found for a provided class.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler_shouldReturnPatientValidatorForPatient
methods.description: Test that the method returns an instance of PatientValidator when asked for a validator for Patient.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler_shouldReturnPersonValidatorForPerson
methods.description: Test that the method returns an instance of PersonValidator when asked for a validator for Person.
